question: The “Make in India” was launched on September 25,_____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2014**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The "**Make in India**" initiative was launched on **September 25, 2014**.
 
• This initiative aims to transform India into a global manufacturing hub by encouraging both multinational and domestic companies to **manufacture their products within the country**.
 
• It focuses on 25 sectors of the economy, including automobiles, textiles, chemicals, and information technology, among others.
 
• The initiative seeks to **create jobs, boost the economy, and enhance the skill set of the workforce**.
 
• It also aims to increase investment, foster innovation, and build best-in-class manufacturing infrastructure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The "Make in India" initiative was launched by Prime Minister **Narendra Modi**.
 
• The initiative has significantly improved India's ease of doing business ranking, attracting f**oreign direct investment** (FDI) and boosting the country's manufacturing sector.
 
• Government policies under this initiative include the simplification of regulatory processes, development of infrastructure, and the provision of incentives to manufacturers.
 
• Special focus is given to sectors like defense manufacturing, electronics, and pharmaceuticals to reduce dependency on imports and enhance self-reliance.
 
• The "Make in India" logo, a striding lion made of cogs, symbolizes manufacturing strength and national pride.
